title: Block Synthesis Manifest
description: Per-block provenance manifest (W3). One object per emitted Courseforge Block, persisted as a sidecar JSONL line at 03_content_development/block_synthesis_manifest.jsonl. Assembles the scattered provenance facts (source chunk list, per-claim attribution, template/slot identity, model+params from the Touch chain, concept_tags) into one canonical per-block record. RESOLUTION scope only — completeness + existence, NOT entailment (W4 owns NLI grounding of prose vs chunk).

block_id.description: Mirrors Block.block_id; the JSONL line key for synthesisManifestRef joins.

block_type.description: Block.block_type; one of the canonical 16-value BLOCK_TYPES enum.

sequence.description: Block.sequence — emission order within the page.

source_chunk_ids.description: Union of the outline source_refs[].sourceId resolved to DART chunk ids plus every key_claims[].source_chunk_ids[]. May be empty for scaffolding block_types; non-empty asserted only for substantive types by ManifestCompletenessValidator.

source_refs.description: Verbatim copy of the outline source_refs[] (the DART sourceId list with roles). Unresolved sourceIds are preserved here even when omitted from source_chunk_ids.

char_spans.description: Per-cited-chunk span record. char_span + html_xpath are lifted from the resolved chunk's source.char_span / source.html_xpath (whole-chunk reference today; span_granularity flags the precision).

span_granularity.description: 'chunk' = whole-chunk reference (the honest default today). 'subchunk' reserved for future sub-span capture; flagged so consumers never mistake whole-chunk reference for sub-chunk precision.

key_claims.description: W2 output recorded verbatim. Present iff the outline emitted structured claims.

template_id.description: The deterministic template that shaped the block (Block.template_type, or the content_type_label / block_type fallback).

slot_ids.description: Filled slot ids when the block was produced by slot-fill. Empty/absent for whole-block free-text emits.

synthesis.description: Model + params read from the Touch chain + block_*_call captures; NOT re-logged here.

tiers.description: One entry per Touch in Block.touched_by.

concept_tags.description: Block-scoped, chunk-grounded concept tags (extract_concept_tags(block) intersected with the cited chunks' concept_tags). May be empty for scaffolding block_types; non-empty asserted only for substantive types per the validator.

content_hash.description: Block.content_hash when present — lets a manifest be matched to the exact block bytes it describes.
